content: Official gsd-core capability documentation and installed 1.12.0 source establish a feature capability taskContentResolver with a unique kebab-case trackerPrefix and bounded invoke {binary,args containing {{id}},timeoutMs <=120000}. The resolve-content router matches a task by tracker-id and emits resolved content only for a non-empty description; ambiguous resolver, nonzero exit, timeout, and malformed stdout are nonzero hard halts with no inline fallback.
